name: keytrace-monorepo
description: A Keystroke-Dynamics Classifier for Continuous Behavioural User Authentication

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "API,WEB" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w @keytrace/web"
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @keytrace/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w api
